execution.description: Put the constructor campaign's ceiling to the owner after #504 became the Constructor, and recorded the answer.

expected: The constructor campaign is held to the USD 5.00 ceiling of OWNER-CHALLENGE-STEP4-01 item 3.
observed: After the re-scope #504's runner registers the constructor campaign at GRAPHITE-GRANT-PHASE3's ceiling less cleanup (USD 14.75). Asked to keep USD 5.00 or let it use #504's grant, the owner answered "let it use it". The USD 5.00 ceiling now applies to the Attacker campaign only.
keep: When a re-scope moves a block under another grant, put its ceiling to the owner and record the verbatim answer in place as an amendment.
change: Record each campaign's ceiling beside the grant that funds it, in the Challenge's campaign record, so a re-scope shows which ceiling binds.
